review_comments.body: Using `_find_tool_call_end` for every `</function>` makes long, otherwise valid function payloads quadratic in their parameter count: inside the loop, `end_re.search(text, pos)` scans from each parameter to the final closing tag. With `'<function=fn>' + '<parameter=p>x</parameter>'*N + '</function>'`, I measured ~0.006 s at N=1,000, ~0.022 s at 2,000, ~0.086 s at 4,000 and ~0.34 s at 8,000 (roughly 4x per doubling). This undermines the claimed linear scan and can stall larger generated calls. Could we locate the candidate end tag once and advance the parameter scan without re-searching the same suffix, with a scaling regression?
